Name: Judge skin
Author: Ciclotauro
Description:
Changes the cat to Judge from the game OFF
This is my first mod, maybe can have some error on the sprites
Install:
1. Navigate to: 'Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals'
2. Backup your 'cat.xnb'
3. Place downloaded 'cat.xnb' in the folder directory written above

All sprites used are from the game
